title: Studio 菜单：组织级（~org / ~all）下「自动化」分组标题显示 0，下面却有「组织级流程」
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

Part of #36890. Found on PR #37169's showcase walk and verified on main by the seat's L1 (7152310574).

## What

- On `/studio/~org/metadata/flow?source=runtime`, and on `/studio/~all/metadata`, the left menu's Automation group header shows **0** (title "0 types"). It sits directly above the group's one entry, 「Organization flows」, so a builder reads it as "nothing here".
- Read on main `3570b814`:
  - `StudioMenu.tsx:204` counts only `kind === 'type'` entries.
  - Off a package, `studioMenuData.ts:83` keeps only the environment catalog types (`metadataAreaHost.ts:74`: permission, position, sharing_rule, capability), so Automation has no type entry.
  - `studioMenuModel.ts:126` still pushes `orgFlows` into the group, and `:145` keeps any non-empty group.
- This predates #36903. Main's `/studio/~org/automations` shows the same 0.

## Fix

The ruled menu tier (#37192 → #37201) removes group-header counts entirely (proposal §3.3). This card closes when #37201 lands, with a `~org` case in `StudioMenu.test.tsx` asserting no count above Organization flows.

If #37201 slips, the minimal fix is to draw no count on a group that has no type entry.

Blocked-by: #37201
